title: Finite direct image detects the zero module sheaf
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring in Type (u+1), let f:X→Y be a finite morphism of schemes in universe u, and let H be a ModuleCat Λ-valued sheaf on X_et [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. If the direct image f_*H [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is zero, then H is zero.

proof.text: Use the existing proved source declaration isZero_of_isZero_lowerStar_of_isFinite with A=ModuleCat Λ. Its proof uses the finite stalk product: at a geometric point of X the counit f^*f_*H→H is the projection onto the corresponding factor, so is epic, including every nonempty geometric fibre. Stalk conservativity makes the sheaf counit epic. Since f_*H=0, exact inverse image gives f^*f_*H=0; epimorphy of 0→H forces H=0. An empty fibre contains no geometric point to check. The source proof works for the indicated module universe and requires no finiteness of Λ.
